title: TRIA QWA data schema for ring measurements
description: Schema for ring-level measurements in a QWA dataset.

image_label.title: Image label
image_label.description: Identifying code for the image; join key to QWAimages and cells

year.title: Year
year.description: Calendar year of the annual ring

cno.title: Cell count
cno.description: Number of cells detected in the ring; derived from the cells component

mrw.title: Mean ring width
mrw.description: Mean radial width of the annual ring

ra.title: Ring area
ra.description: Total area of the annual ring in the image (in linear samples without extrapolation to sector limits (net area), in circular samples with extrapolation to sector limits, even if outside of image)

rvgi.title: Ring vessel grouping index
rvgi.description: Vessel grouping index per annual rings: Mean number of cells per group (solitary cells are also considered as a group)

rvsf.title: Ring vessel solitary fraction
rvsf.description: Vessel solitary fraction per annual rings: Fraction of solitary cells with respect to all cells

rgsgv.title: Ring group size of grouped vessels
rgsgv.description: Mean group size of grouped / non-solitary cells per annual rings;

aoiar.title: Area of interest area
aoiar.description: Cumulative area of all AOI's within each annual ring

dhw.title: Hydraulically weighted mean diameter
dhw.description: Ring-level hydraulically weighted mean diameter (sum(cell_dh^5)/sum(cell_dh^4); (Kolb & Sperry, 1998))

dhm.title: Mean hydraulic diameter
dhm.description: Mean hydraulic diameter per ring (sum(cell_dh^4)/cno)^0.25; (Tyree & Zimmermann, 2002))

eww.title: Earlywood width
eww.description: Estimated earlywood width based on Mork's index threshold

duplicate_ring.title: Duplicate ring flag
duplicate_ring.description: TRUE if the same year appears in more than one image due to overlapping slides.

exclude_dupl.title: Exclude duplicate flag
exclude_dupl.description: TRUE for the duplicate ring(s) not selected as the preferred source (default values derived from cell count ranking)

exclude_issues.title: Exclude issues flag
exclude_issues.description: TRUE for rings that should be excluded from analyses due to data quality issues (e.g. incomplete rings)

affected_tissue.title: Affected tissue
affected_tissue.description: Can be used to indicate whether the data quality issue(s) affect the entire or only part of the ring

incomplete_ring.title: Incomplete ring flag
incomplete_ring.description: TRUE if the ring is at the inner or outer image border and the true ring boundary is not fully visible; mrw is unreliable or unavailable

missing_ring.title: Missing ring flag
missing_ring.description: TRUE if (almost) no cells were detected or ring was added manually during cross-dating (e.g. a wedging ring)

x_dating.title: Crossdating issue
x_dating.description: Data quality flag: crossdating problem detected for this ring.

compression_wood.title: Compression wood
compression_wood.description: Data quality flag: compression wood present.

orientation.title: Orientation issue
orientation.description: Data quality flag: section orientation problem affecting measurements.

out_of_focus.title: Out of focus
out_of_focus.description: Technical quality flag: image is out of focus.

cracks.title: Cracks
cracks.description: Technical quality flag: cracks visible in the section.

paraffin.title: Paraffin
paraffin.description: Technical quality flag: paraffin residue visible.

compressed_cells.title: Compressed cells
compressed_cells.description: Technical quality flag: cells are mechanically compressed.

overlapping_cells.title: Overlapping cells
overlapping_cells.description: Technical quality flag: cells overlap in the image.

broken_cells.title: Broken cells
broken_cells.description: Technical quality flag: broken or damaged cells present.

tang_incomplete.title: Tangentially incomplete
tang_incomplete.description: Technical quality flag: ring is cut off at the tangential image border.

tyloses.title: Tyloses
tyloses.description: Other issue flag: tyloses present in vessels.

decay.title: Decay
decay.description: Other issue flag: wood decay visible.

other_disqual.title: Other issue
other_disqual.description: Other issue flag: other data quality issue.

blue_ring.title: Blue ring
blue_ring.description: Discrete feature flag: blue ring (freeze damage during cell expansion).

frost_ring.title: Frost ring
frost_ring.description: Discrete feature flag: frost ring (freeze damage during cell wall formation).

light_ring.title: Light ring
light_ring.description: Discrete feature flag: light ring (absence of latewood).

iadf.title: Intra-annual density fluctuation
iadf.description: Discrete feature flag: intra-annual density fluctuation.

traum_resin_ducts.title: Traumatic resin ducts
traum_resin_ducts.description: Discrete feature flag: presence of traumatic resin ducts.

trabeculae.title: Trabeculae
trabeculae.description: Discrete feature flag: presence of trabeculae.

other_discrete.title: Other discrete feature
other_discrete.description: Discrete feature flag: other discrete features.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Additional comments (not imported to TRIA DB)
